title: alchemilla vulgaris var. lineata
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris var. lineata, commonly known as the Lady's mantle, is a perennial flowering plant species belonging to the family Rosaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce menstrual cramps, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of Lady's mantle include its astringent, anti-spasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing, reducing bleeding, and relieving urinary tract issues. The bioactive constituents of Lady's malt include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
